node.label: cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 2
node.definition: An autosomal recessive cerebral arteriopathy with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy caused by a variation in the HTRA1 gene, characterized by early-onset gait disturbances, premature scalp alopecia, ischemic stroke, acute mid to lower back pain and progressive cognitive disturbances leading to severe dementia.
synonyms: cerebrovascular disease with thin skin, alopecia, and disc disease

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — HtrA serine peptidase 1
